description.en: A quality broadsheet: newsprint, column rules, serif headlines and line-hatched drawings.
description.tr: Kaliteli bir gazete sayfası: gazete kağıdı, sütun çizgileri, serif başlıklar ve taramalı çizimler.

colorRules.ink: every outline, hatching, rule, headline and number
colorRules.accent: one element per scene at most: the key bar, one framed panel, one marker dot or an underline

display.use: headlines and big numbers, tight leading, never all caps for long lines
display.numbers: lining figures: font-variant-numeric: lining-nums (the default old-style figures drop below the line)

text.use: kickers, captions, pull quotes and labels; kickers in small caps letter-spaced

hatching.shadeBands: parallel straight lines only, never crosshatching; denser spacing (6) for darker areas

paper.grain: seeded SVG feTurbulence, very faint speckle, opacity about 0.06

layout.columnRule: one thin vertical rule at the left third, full height, like a page gutter
layout.frames: framed panels with a 2px ink border and generous inner margin, like boxed newspaper graphics
layout.grid: content sits on a 12 column grid; panels align to column edges

motion.rules: rules draw on first along their length, then frames, then contents
motion.hatching: hatch lines sweep in one after another along the hatch direction, about 0.6 s per area
motion.headline: headline words set in one by one with a short upward slide inside a mask, like type being placed
motion.camera: slow calm pushes and vertical pans down the page, like reading a broadsheet
motion.transition: a column rule wipes across the frame and the next layout is revealed behind it, or a page turn feel made with a vertical wipe
